Choose the tools for your game

One table.
Two different jobs.

Character Workshop helps with the initial character import. 5.5e Automation adds supported gameplay assistance to the table. They complement each other, but the importer does not require the automation module.

Neither module includes the source books. Install your chosen content separately, give players access to the relevant compendiums, and review each module’s requirements before enabling it.
